reviewCadence: At every business workflow, authorization policy, quota, idempotency, billing, signup, login, or sensitive state-transition change.

requirements.name: Re-derive security-relevant values server-side
requirements.owasp: Never trust client-side decisions; derive prices, limits, regions, roles, and status from authoritative data.

controls.name: Checkout and registration server decisions
controls.description: Block client-controlled business outcomes by deriving billing lock state, registration region, data region, and profile acceptance on the server.

requirements.name: Model sensitive workflows as server state machines
requirements.owasp: Enforce expected steps, expiry, and transitions server-side instead of trusting the UI path.

controls.name: Authentication state and challenge lifecycle
controls.description: Persist short-lived authentication state, require the expected next step, and consume challenges when they are completed.

requirements.name: Reject replay and concurrent double execution
requirements.owasp: Treat replay, duplicate submission, and timing races as business logic attacks.

controls.name: In-flight idempotency claim
controls.description: Reserve an idempotency key before executing a mutating request, return 409 for a concurrent duplicate, and only release the claim after the response is persisted for replay.

requirements.name: Constrain abuse-friendly features
requirements.owasp: Rate-limit and monitor workflows attackers can profit from at scale.

controls.name: Multi-key rate limits and bot controls
controls.description: Apply independent IP and scoped-key rate limits to sensitive flows and keep the anti-automation controls wired into the root security gate.

requirements.name: Authorize from business context
requirements.owasp: Avoid implicit permissions; combine actor role, resource ownership, target role, and active policy.

controls.name: Contextual workspace authorization
controls.description: Evaluate business permissions from action, actor role, ownership, target role, and workspace policy instead of trusting a coarse role check.

requirements.name: Validate business meaning, not just type shape
requirements.owasp: Reject values and combinations that are syntactically valid but invalid for the business process.

controls.name: Semantic registration and quota validation
controls.description: Validate legal acceptance, username normalization and length, backend-derived supported regions, and quota/spend-cap semantics server-side.

requirements.name: Observe business security decisions
requirements.owasp: Log and monitor denied, risky, or unusual business-flow decisions.

controls.name: Audit and risk event evidence
controls.description: Record auth, billing, and bot/security decisions so business-logic abuse is visible to investigation and alerting workflows.

requirements.name: Regression-test business invariants
requirements.owasp: Turn abuse-oriented business invariants into automated regression checks.

controls.name: Business security registry gate
controls.description: Fail the root check when business-logic controls, evidence, or the new in-flight idempotency implementation are removed.
